review_notes:
I reviewed all 72 lines of the target file. It has one theorem and no simp attributes of its own. I also read the declarations it depends on. `cubicThetaOmegaUnit` is defined in CubicThetaRamifiedMiddleSupport.lean. `cubicThetaNegativeInverseUnit_power` and `cubicThetaRamifiedTop_negative_inverse` are in CubicThetaRamifiedTopPhase.lean, and `cubicThetaOmegaUnit_inverse_value` is in CubicThetaRamifiedPhaseRows.lean. I grepped the project for every use of `cubicThetaOmegaUnit`. In Mathlib I checked the simp status of `Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val` and `Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne`; both are tagged simp.

The only simp-interface problem this file shows is the lack of a canonical coercion lemma for `cubicThetaOmegaUnit`. Because of it, the proof of `hd` has to unfold the definition, and the same unfolding appears in many sibling files.

I considered also proposing a simp lemma for the coercion of `(cubicThetaOmegaUnit^j)⁻¹`, which is needed at lines 24–27. I left it out because a canonical form for `omegaE^(2j)` would need reduction modulo 3, which is not a simple oriented rewrite. The rest of the proof uses explicit `rw` with local facts and has no simp-related issues. I did not run Lean, so the proposed `simp [d]` replacement has not been compiled.

findings.problem: The proof needs `((cubicThetaOmegaUnit^j : Eisensteinˣ) : Eisenstein) = omegaE^j`. The desired normal form of `↑cubicThetaOmegaUnit` is `omegaE`, but no lemma states this. The proof therefore unfolds the definition `cubicThetaOmegaUnit` to its `Units.mkOfMulEqOne omegaE (omegaE^2) _` body and then applies Mathlib's `Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne`. That exposes an implementation detail, including the proof term inside the unit, at the use site. The same four-item unfolding is copied across the project. It appears in CubicThetaRamifiedTopPhase (line 46), CubicThetaRamifiedResidueFormula (lines 37, 56, 61), CubicThetaUnitPhaseSymbol (lines 58, 67, 68, 71, 74) and CubicThetaRamifiedPhaseRows (line 21). Other sites use `simpa [cubicThetaOmegaUnit]` or `norm_num [cubicThetaOmegaUnit]`. `Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val` is already simp, so this one coercion lemma is the only missing link.
findings.proposed_change:
Next to the definition in CubicThetaRamifiedMiddleSupport.lean, add
`@[simp] lemma val_cubicThetaOmegaUnit : ((cubicThetaOmegaUnit : Eisensteinˣ) : Eisenstein) = omegaE := rfl`
(or prove it with `Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne _`). Then write `hd` here as `by simp [d]` (or `simp only [d, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, val_cubicThetaOmegaUnit]`), and stop unfolding `cubicThetaOmegaUnit` at the other sites. The lemma rewrites a coercion of a named constant to an existing atom, so it moves terms toward a smaller form and cannot loop.
findings.benefit: With this lemma, the default simp set turns `↑(cubicThetaOmegaUnit^j)` into `omegaE^j` without unfolding the definition. Proofs then no longer depend on how the unit is built through `mkOfMulEqOne`. About a dozen copies of the same `simp only` list across sibling files collapse to a call to one stable lemma, and future uses (such as the `hd` in this file) can use plain `simp`.
